items.summary: Align Web reference input and recall ordering.
items.rationale: Preserve the interaction principle after AAEP product-flow review rather than copying upstream presentation wholesale.

items.summary: Pin the current blank New Session row first without persisting a false permanent order.
items.rationale: The state/render separation is valuable for workspace UX and should be adapted to AAEP session semantics.

items.summary: Render terminal turn errors after same-turn retries are exhausted.
items.rationale: Explicit terminal failure evidence is useful, but AAEP error/retry semantics must follow its own runtime and acceptance contracts.

items.summary: Introduce structured index injection and client boot seams.
items.rationale: Boot seams improve host/client replaceability, but deployment and frontend-serving decisions remain AAEP-owned.

items.summary: Upstream UI primitives and product visual language are treated as reference material only.
items.rationale: AAEP owns its product visual identity, information architecture and branding; interaction ideas may be studied without inheriting upstream identity.
